predictions.claim: Gold will continue to rise and potentially reach $3,500 in the near term
predictions.excerpt: So, we've talked about this for years. Gold always moves first because gold is bought by big investors on the hundreds of millions or billion scale. That's why you're looking at a global market in the trillions and then the rest of us following around on the coattails are going to move into the less expensive alternatives like silver. There's a reason it's been called the poor man's gold forever. Forever. But you know, one thing too I want to interject. The bond market is three to four times the size of the stock market. Yep. And people are focused on the stock market because that's what's put in front of them every night on the news. But at the same time, when you talk to a financial advisor and you say, "Well, how do I protect myself from say a fallout in the stock market? If equities were to drop, what do I do?" What's been their solution, Tori? Well, buy bonds. Buy bonds. That's the hedge. That's been the flight to safety or flight to quality, right? And they'll tell you, well, you're 70% equities and 30% in bonds or 50/50. That's more conservative, but not according to Jamie Diamond, not according to Paul Tudtor Jones. Well, certainly not going forward. I mean, their warning signs are for going forward. But you can look back and a position of gold in your portfolio far outperforms a bond position for the last 25 years. The problem is a lot of financial adviserss or money managers aren't going to get paid to manage your physical gold position. It kind of is out there where nobody can see it. And so there tends to be a bias or sometimes there's an ignorance. And I don't mean that from a slanderous standpoint. I just mean look gold averages 8 12% return a year over the last 40 years 50 years find that in a bond return and it provides that downside protection. So the draw down on your portfolio when the stocks actually do end up seeing those major pullbacks. Gold is a much better hedge than the bonds have been. And now we're talking about going forward these guys are all in on the gold and they're bond market experts.
